6637cc84eb.q: What is the LDAP program structure and duration through NACAP?
6637cc84eb.a: LDAP is a nine-month online program that starts February 1st and ends by the end of October. It is built into three eight-week modules, with breaks between each module, for a total of 21 lectures or panels delivered throughout the program.

32ea68133b.q: Why did NACAP create the Leadership Development for Enrollment Professionals program?
32ea68133b.a: NACAP created the program because they observed a changing of the guard with many chief enrollment officers retiring or leaving the profession, and the benches at institutions were shallow with not enough next-generation leaders ready to take on the chief role. They wanted to help raise up the next generation of enrollment leaders.

27c09f6f8f.q: What key professional skills do modern enrollment professionals need that differ from 5-10 years ago?
27c09f6f8f.a: Modern enrollment professionals must focus on retaining all-stars as this generation changes jobs frequently (averaging 12 jobs over a career versus Greg's 40-year tenure at one institution). They must also develop stronger data analysis skills due to limited resources, understand artificial intelligence applications, demonstrate outcomes to families and students, and have courage to take calculated risks and change quickly rather than maintain the status quo.

1b774da5cb.q: How should job descriptions for enrollment professionals incorporate professional development beyond tasks?
1b774da5cb.a: Job descriptions should have two components: tasks or responsibilities, and competencies to develop in people. During one-on-ones, managers should discuss not just whether tasks were completed but also competencies like winsome communication, and provide opportunities for growth. Competencies should also be part of promotion criteria, as people gaining in competencies are the ones leaders should promote to the next level.

1a1ab6add9.q: What low-cost professional development alternatives exist for institutions with limited budgets?
1a1ab6add9.a: Leaders can invest in one key individual at a time rather than trying to fund everyone at once. They can hire a consultant or lecturer to come on-campus for a half or full day of training for under $1,500, allowing the whole team to attend. Alternatively, employees can engage independently with podcasts, books, LinkedIn connections, and Zoom calls to drive their own professional development.
